results.question: #How many days of annual leave do employees get?
results.answer: Annual leave depends on your country and company policy. In many European countries, including Finland, employees typically receive about 24–30 days of paid annual leave per year. Always check your employment contract or HR handbook for the exact amount. (Source 1)
